harnesses.name: voice
harnesses.runtime: tiny-voca ONNX (voices nous-girl F2 / hermes-agent M2, 24 kHz)
harnesses.fallback: offline espeak at 24 kHz with viseme emission disabled; receipt records degraded mode
harnesses.description: Speaks authored text with the two OpenSourceWare voices (nous-girl F2, hermes-agent M2) through the tiny-voca ONNX runtime and derives phoneme-timed visemes for lip sync.

harnesses.name: ffmpeg
harnesses.fallback: fixed libx264/aac pipeline without agentic repair; receipt records degraded mode
harnesses.description: Assembles deterministic PIL frames and tiny-voca narration into H.264/AAC 9:16 video, then gates acceptance on ffprobe, volumedetect, frame count, duration, bright pixels, sha256, and ledger linkage under HUMAN://ROOT.

harnesses.name: control
harnesses.fallback: local VLC RC interface with single-node playback; mesh nodes are skipped and recorded as unavailable
harnesses.description: Controls playback across a mesh of VLC nodes for human review of finished clips, keeping every play/pause/seek action receipted.

harnesses.name: physics
harnesses.fallback: kinematic interpolation with contact dynamics disabled; receipt records non-physical mode
harnesses.description: Steps real MuJoCo 4.0.1 dynamics for the 25 actuated degrees of freedom (nu=25) and returns qpos traces consumed by the viewport and robot harnesses.

harnesses.name: viewport
harnesses.fallback: Pillow 2D compositor with perspective projection disabled; receipt records flat-render mode
harnesses.description: Renders the MuJoCo qpos stream as a 9:16 Three.js/WebGL viewport of the Asimov-1 body for capture and review. Adds read-only DOM awareness for the hermes-agent Asimov robot.
harnesses.dom: read-only CDP projection of a live viewport: viewport, landmarks, controls, headings, data-slots, focus, selection

harnesses.name: robot
harnesses.fallback: frozen rest pose with no locomotion; receipt records that the robot model was unavailable
harnesses.description: Drives the 25-DOF hermes-asimov Asimov-1 humanoid, from fixed-base physics capture to mocap-guided free walk solved by MuJoCo. Policy-driven gait is available through the ONNX locomotion harness.

harnesses.name: publish
harnesses.fallback: write artifacts to a local dist directory with no push; receipt records unpublished state
harnesses.description: Generates the gallery index with generate_gallery and publishes finished videos and hero pages to the GitHub Pages gh-pages branch under human authority.

harnesses.name: course
harnesses.fallback: captioned slides-only video with narration disabled; receipt records silent-course mode
harnesses.description: Synthesizes two-voice OpenSourceWare lessons (osw-101, osw-102, osw-103) from a JSON script into a 9:16 course video with a COURSE:// receipt.

harnesses.name: ledger
harnesses.fallback: append to a local plaintext journal with chain verification disabled; receipt records unverified mode
harnesses.description: The unified, tamper-evident receipt ledger: a SHA-256 hash chain anchored at GENESIS under HUMAN://ROOT, persisted as ae-receipts.jsonl, that records every harness action.
